proves.claim: judge turns collected section results into a pure per-section verdict and code.

receipt.judge.sections.why: The verdict must be reproducible from the results alone, with a lost section judged infra.

proves.claim: the verdict is recorded first and bookkeeping after it cannot change it.

receipt.settle.order.why: A bookkeeping failure once could lose or alter a recorded verdict.

proves.claim: a receipt key is stable per candidate and base and refuses a missing id.

receipt.key.stable.why: Reuse and review find a receipt only by this key.

proves.claim: runs with the same candidate and base but different tooling pins get different receipt keys and never reuse each other.

receipt.key.tooling.why: A receipt proved under other tooling is not proof under this tooling.

proves.claim: a submit receipt is reusable at landing only for the same candidate and base and a green verdict.

receipt.reuse.composition.why: Reusing a receipt for a moved base or changed candidate would land unproven work.

proves.claim: review reads a receipt by its key from a list or a map.

receipt.review.by-key.why: Review must cite the receipt for the exact candidate and base.

proves.claim: a main-red key is tree, file and command, and one key makes one main-test job id.

receipt.main-key.job.why: Enqueueing a main-test job is idempotent on this id.

proves.claim: whether a file is red on main is answered from its keyed receipt alone, and a missing receipt is reported missing.

receipt.main-status.receipt-only.why: No process holds current main reds; the receipt is the only source.

proves.claim: reds all named by main's receipt are main's own; any other red is the candidate's.

receipt.main-classify.owner.why: A candidate must not be blamed for main's red, nor excused for its own.

proves.claim: the signed statement names job, shard, tree and digest, and the key id is a sha256 hex.

receipt.signed.statement.why: Signing the names stops a good result being posted as another job's.

proves.claim: a valid runner signature passes and every missing, unsigned, malformed or foreign one is import.invalid, never red.

receipt.signed.check.why: An untrusted sandbox's verdict counts only through the runner's registered key (DJ31).

proves.claim: a result in which every section is skip judges red with code ALL_SKIP, and one real pass still judges green.

receipt.judge.all-skip.why: An all-skip run proves nothing, so it must never read as green.

proves.claim: a signed runner result whose fields are concatenated differently fails to verify.

receipt.signed.concat.why: Length-prefixed fields stop two field lists from signing the same text (#8035).

proves.claim: a result signed for one attempt, base, tooling pin or command fails to verify for any other.

receipt.signed.binding.why: Binding these fields stops a good result being replayed for another attempt, base, pin or command (#8035).

proves.claim: every test in the receipt cell carries a stable ID and exactly one complete record.

receipt.registry.complete.why: Items, census and baselines key on IDs, so a test without a record or a record without a test is a hole.

proves.claim: every refusal of reusable says reuse is false, and only a full match says true.

receipt.reuse.refusals.why: A refusal that read as reusable would land unproven work.

proves.claim: receiptKey refuses a candidate or base that is empty, missing or not a string.

receipt.key.types.why: A bad id would key two receipts together or lose one.

proves.claim: a public key or signature of the wrong type is import.invalid even when its text would pass.

receipt.signed.types.why: A coerced value must never stand in for a real key or signature (DJ31).

proves.claim: a section keeps its own non-empty string code, and any other code reads null.

receipt.judge.code.why: The verdict code must come only from a real section code.

proves.claim: every receipt test that reads repo files names the exact files it reads in its header, never a whole cell.

receipt.inputs.declared.why: Affected-test selection can only see a reader whose inputs are declared.

proves.claim: the reader rule reports no undeclared reader in the receipt tests with the outside-src rule on.

receipt.inputs.rule-clean.why: The rule going on must not turn this cell red.
